top_reviews.title: Absolutely love these sneakers.
top_reviews.text: I have painful feet do to a number of conditions. These have been the most comfortable, also recommended by my podiatrist.

top_reviews.title: Great fit for large feet and look great!
top_reviews.text:
I was a little cautious buying these sandals because I read a lot of reviews saying they were for narrow feet and I consider myself to have quite large wide feet, size 11. But when I got these they fit perfectly! I even had to tighten the straps because they were a bit too loose. It may just be proportional to the size of your foot, but I am so happy that these fit!

I can’t yet review the comfort of these shoes as we still have quite a bit of snow of the ground, but initially they feel quite nice. I bought these for a trip with lots of walking in a hotter climate so I will update on how they work after that.
